name: animated-modal
blurb: 3D spring-animated modal with blur backdrop and outside-click dismissal.
description: A compound modal component with spring-driven 3D entrance animation, blurred background, automatic scroll locking, and keyboard/click-outside dismissal.
use_when: Showing important dialogs with a polished, animated entrance that captures attention.
avoid_when: For simple confirmations — standard alert-dialog is lighter weight.
a11y: Has close button and keyboard dismissal; relies on children for semantic content. No explicit focus trap.
